detail: A side-view or orbit-around camera option for recordings (GB_CAM or similar) so kicks are visible.
done_when: a recording where an extended kick is readable
result: GB_CAM=side|front|back|orbit[:deg/s] in crates/game/src/play/camera.rs (commit ca047e5). Built and recorded: staging/showcase/cam_kick.mp4 shows the flying side kick in profile (airborne, leg out), cam_berserk.mp4 the berserk fight from the side. Not tried: front/back/orbit modes in a recording; behaviour with lock-on during fights beyond one clip.
title: Camera for showing moves
